newsitem.title: USA: Biogenesis & Weston to analyze NY harbor.
newsitem.headline: Biogenesis & Weston to analyze NY harbor.

text.p: Biogenesis Enterprises Inc and Roy F. Weston Inc said Tuesday they are teaming up to clean contaminants from New York-New Jersey harbor sediments.

Biogenesis of New Jersey LLC will lead the work starting in July, a statement said. Biogenesis said it will use soil and sediment washing technologies to demonstrate decontamination of dredged sediments.
The work is part of the New York-New Jersey harbor sediment decontamination program under the Water Resources Development Act.
Biogenis is a private environmental technology firm based in Milwaukee. Weston is an international consulting firm.
